changes.sourceChinese: 至今太后發憤，一旦升遐。
changes.before: And now the Empress Dowager, overcome with indignation, has suddenly passed away.
changes.after: Matters came to the point that the Empress Dowager, overcome with indignation, suddenly passed away.
changes.reason: Proposed retrospective rendering of the outcome of the Su Jun/Zu Yue crisis; avoid presenting the dowager’s death as a fresh event during this later memorial. Independently check the interpretation of 至今 against the complete memorial and dated source witness before approval.

changes.sourceChinese: 至今太后發憤，一旦升遐。
changes.before: Until now the Empress Dowager gave vent to her indignation and in one morning ascended to distant heaven.
changes.after: It came to this: the Empress Dowager gave vent to her indignation and in one morning ascended to distant heaven.
changes.reason: Proposed retrospective rendering of the outcome of the Su Jun/Zu Yue crisis; avoid presenting the dowager’s death as a fresh event during this later memorial. Independently check the interpretation of 至今 against the complete memorial and dated source witness before approval.

contextUnits.zh: 陛下命世天挺，當隆晉道，而遭國多難，殷憂備嬰，追述往事，至今楚灼。

translations.literal: Your Majesty is heaven-born to the age, destined to exalt Jin's Way, yet has encountered many hardships of state; deep grief presses on every side; recalling past affairs, to this day one burns with anguish.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty is heaven-born to the age, destined to exalt Jin's Way, yet has encountered many hardships of state; deep grief presses on every side, and recalling past affairs still burns with anguish to this day.

contextUnits.zh: 跡其所由，實因故司空亮居元舅之尊，勢業之重，執政裁下，輕侮邊將，故令蘇峻、祖約不勝其忿，遂致敗國。

translations.literal: Tracing where it came from, it was truly because the late Minister of Works Yu Liang occupied the honor of chief maternal uncle and the weight of power and achievement, governed and judged subordinates, and lightly insulted frontier generals, so that Su Jun and Zu Yue could not contain their rage and thus brought disaster on the state.
translations.idiomatic: Tracing where it came from, it was truly because the late Minister of Works Yu Liang occupied the honor of chief maternal uncle and the weight of power and achievement, governed and judged subordinates, and lightly insulted frontier generals, so that Su Jun and Zu Yue could not contain their rage and thus brought disaster on the state.

contextUnits.zh: 至今太后發憤，一旦升遐。

translations.literal: Until now the Empress Dowager gave vent to her indignation and in one morning ascended to distant heaven.
translations.idiomatic: And now the Empress Dowager, overcome with indignation, has suddenly passed away.

contextUnits.zh: 若社稷不靈，人神無助，豺狼之心當可極邪！

translations.literal: If the altars were not numinous and men and spirits gave no aid, would the heart of wolves and jackals be allowed to reach its limit!
translations.idiomatic: Had the altars not been numinous and men and spirits not aided us, would the hearts of wolves and jackals have been allowed to run their course!
